records.algorithm_name: P2 四构造官方保护组合

protocol.authorization: Ongoing user-authorized P2 iteration; all callable local/Colab resources allowed without conflicting sessions; separately bounded second batch
protocol.selection: same proposal order; skip if certified assigned-pipe lower bound >= confirmed incumbent; otherwise strict successful E0 improvement
protocol.sample_status: same six development cases; timing follow-up, not new quality/holdout evidence
acceptance: same selected plan SHA-256 and complete final result bytes as first batch for all six
18 online + 6 final E0 expected; report actual calls even if different
all 24 plans and all skipped-bound certificates retained
report outer solver wall including online scoring; final E0 separate; concurrent machine, no clean causal timing claim

parameters.sample_status: same six development cases; runtime pruning check, not new holdout evidence
parameters.observer: ps sum RSS of solver/evaluator descendants, 50ms target sampling; RSS stop also includes this observer. Other sessions excluded; short peaks may be missed; no hard memory guarantee. Concurrent P1/Q3 research loads are not isolated; measured wall is not an exclusive-machine speed claim.

timing.evaluation_precision: time.perf_counter seconds; outer observed process lifetime with up to 50ms polling granularity plus ps/cleanup overhead

solver.method: Same from-graph four proposals and strict E0 incumbent selection; skip an already constructed candidate only if its certified assigned-core pipe-work lower bound cannot strictly improve the incumbent.

environment.gpu: not used; CPU-only Python solver and official evaluator
environment.dependencies: uv.lock sha256=7b03fee57044ac272d8895533cbdca6d70a29d2da955f98a5552e72ef944fdc4; uv sync --locked prepared before this run; no compilation/training

measurement.solver_scope: Fresh solver process Popen through exit, descendant cleanup and return; graph parsing, four constructors and all online E0 included; observer polling overhead included. OS file cache is not flushed.
measurement.evaluation_scope: Separate final official CLI Popen through exit and cleanup; outside solver wall. Full final result bytes compared with selected online E0.
measurement.offline_costs: uv environment sync, source/case extraction and static development precede the run; their wall time was not measured here. No training/compiled evaluator/precomputed per-case plan is loaded by solver.

missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.seed: Deterministic constructors; no random seed is used.

notes: Independent evaluator worker shares parent development context; not a blind scientific review.
Online E0 belongs to solver wall; timing.solver_includes_evaluation=false refers only to the separately reported final E0 wall.

All 24 candidate plans remain in run/online. Bound-pruned entries carry certificates and have no invented E0 result or duration. Compressed official JSON is lossless; raw hashes are in batch.compression.
RSS is sampled across owned descendants, including separate process groups; short peaks may be missed. Observed peak is not a hard bound.
Official singlecore denominator reused with verified hashes and original result; zero new singlecore evaluations.
